222-527-6798-8296.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-6798-8296.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

751-3286-4742.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1981-2415-2921-6772.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Syr Vondam and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Syr Vondam trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Syr Vondam
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on them.
Repeat.

1981-2415-4050-5870.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-4050-5870.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to gain life and get {E}
Repeat.

60-7683.notablePrerequisites: You have another instant or sorcery card in hand with the mana to cast it and applicable target(s) if needed.
60-7683.description:
Cast any other instant or sorcery by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Expansion by paying its mana cost, targeting the instant or sorcery cast in step 1.
Expansion's storm ability triggers, creating at least one copy of Expansion targeting the original Expansion
Resolve a copy of Expansion, copying Expansion targeting the original Expansion
Repeat step 4.

851-2034-5086-5183-7743.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
851-2034-5086-5183-7743.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1.

3212-4875-5256-5659.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing God-Eternal Kefnet.
When God-Eternal Kefnet dies, it triggers, putting itself from your graveyard into your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill cards equal to God-Eternal Kefnet's power, which will cause you to mill God-Eternal Kefnet.
As God-Eternal Kefnet is a Lhurgoyf due to Conspiracy, Disa's first ability triggers, returning God-Eternal Kefnet from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1846-3191-4276-7506.easyPrerequisites: You control at least three Islands
1846-3191-4276-7506.description:
Cast High Tide by paying {U}.
Cast Replicate by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Kairi.
Put the Kairi token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Kairi token dies, it triggers, causing you to mill six cards and return High Tide and Replicate from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast High Tide by paying {U}.
Activate at least three Islands by tapping them, adding {U}{U}{U}.
High Tide triggers twice for each Island tapped this way, adding that much {U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Replicate by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Kairi.
Put the Kairi token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Kairi token dies, it triggers, causing you to mill six cards and return Turnabout and Replicate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 6.

1575-2921-6748.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another artifact, which is a Food due to Ragost.
Nuka-Cola Vending Machine triggers, creating a tapped Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

81-292-4968.description:
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Rite of Passage triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Deathbringer Thoctar.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Move to the next turn, removing all damage marked on Deathbringer Thoctar.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 5 as desired.
81-292-4968.notes: You can remove counters to deal damage to creatures you control, putting infinite +1/+1 counters on them due to Rite of Passage.

1170-2834-2909-6586.description:
Cast Mind Games with buyback by paying {2}{U}{U}.
Displacer Kitten and Vivi trigger.
Resolve the Vivi trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Holding priority, activate Vivi by paying {0}, adding at least {2}{U}{U}.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Vivi.
When Vivi enters the battlefield, Hero's Blade triggers, attaching Hero's Blade to Vivi.
Resolve Mind Games, returning Mind Games to your hand.
Repeat.

11-3280-5195-6526.manaNeeded: {U}{R}{W} plus enough mana to cast the spell that creates a token copy
11-3280-5195-6526.description:
Cast Flamehold Grappler by paying {U}{R}{W}.
When Flamehold Grappler enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying the next spell you cast this turn.
Cast Croaking Counterpart by paying its mana cost, targeting Flamehold Grappler.
Flamehold Grappler and Storm-Kiln Artist trigger.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Flamehold Grappler trigger, copying Croaking Counterpart, with the copy targeting Flamehold Grappler.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the copy of Croaking Counterpart, creating a token copy of Flamehold Grappler.
When the token Flamehold Grappler enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying the next spell you cast this turn.
Holding priority, activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U}{U}.
Cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting Croaking Counterpart
Flamehold Grappler and Storm-Kiln Artist trigger.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Flamehold Grappler trigger, copying Narset's Reversal, with the copy targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, returning the original Narset's Reversal to your hand and creating a copy of Narset's Reversal targeting Croaking Counterpart.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Narset's Reversal copy, returning Croaking Counterpart to your hand and creating a copy of Croaking Counterpart targeting Flamehold Grappler.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Croaking Counterpart copy, creating a token copy of Flamehold Grappler.
When the token Flamehold Grappler enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying the next spell you cast.
Activate up to four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding enough mana to cast Croaking Counterpart.
Repeat from step 3.

511-817-1887-3129-4050.description:
Activate Fungal Bloom by paying {G}{G}, putting two spore counters on a Fungus you control.
Activate a Fungus by removing two spore counters from it, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Saprolings, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

2730-3719-5131-5147.notablePrerequisites:
Kaya's Ghostform attached to Muldrotha.
You have not cast a creature spell using Muldrotha this turn if Ruthless Technomancer is in your graveyard.
2730-3719-5131-5147.description:
Cast Ruthless Technomancer either from your hand or graveyard by paying {3}{B}.
When Ruthless Technomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Muldrotha and create six Treasure artifact tokens.
When Muldrotha dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Muldrotha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Ruthless Technomancer, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate five Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{B}{B}.
Cast Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard by paying {B}, attaching it to Muldrotha.
Repeat.

252-933-4312-4554.manaNeeded: {4}{G}{W}{U}{U} the first turn, and {G}{U} available each extra turn
252-933-4312-4554.notablePrerequisites: Vorel of the Hull Clade does not have summoning sickness.
252-933-4312-4554.description:
Cast Teferi by paying {4}{W}{U}, causing it to enter the battlefield as a 7/7 Dinosaur creature in addition to its other types due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Activate Vorel of the Hull Clade by paying {G}{U} and tapping it, doubling the counters on Teferi.
Activate Teferi's third loyalty ability by removing ten loyalty counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Conjurer's Closet triggers, blinking Teferi, causing it to enter the battlefield as a 7/7 Dinosaur creature in addition to its other types due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Repeat from step 2 each turn.

3783-4050-4300.description:
Optionally, activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Meloku by paying {1} and returning a land you control to your hand, creating a 1/1 Illusion creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Illusion token, adding {1}.
When the Illusion dies, Minn's second ability triggers, putting a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

803-1385-2292-2721-5170.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Bloodline Necromancer.
Zulaport Cutthroat triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Junji.
Zulaport Cutthroat and Junji trigger.
Resolve the Zulaport Cutthroat trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, causing you to lose 2 life and to put Bloodline Necromancer from your graveyard onto the battlefield under your control.
Bloodline Necromancer enters the battlefield, causing you to return Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 4, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

1183-2440.description:
Activate Pentavus, removing a +1/+1 counter and making a Pentavite token.
Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C}.
Activate Pentavus again, removing a +1/+1 counter and making a Pentavite token.
Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Pentavus a third time, removing a +1/+1 counter, making a Pentavite token, and leaving {C} floating.
Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}, leaving {C}{C}{C}{C} floating.
Activate Pentavus' other ability 3 times, sacrificing the 3 Pentavite tokens and putting 3 +1/+1 counters back on Pentavus.
Repeat for infinite colorless mana.

328-3260-4050-4078.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is 10 or greater.
You have at least two opponents, or your devotion to black is at least ten.
328-3260-4050-4078.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Gray Merchant.
Activate Chainer by paying 9 life due to K'rrik, returning Gray Merchant from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Nightmare in addition to its other creature types.
When Gray Merchant enters, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to your devotion to black and causing you to gain that much life.
Repeat.
328-3260-4050-4078.notes: The additional gained life can be used by Chainer to return all creature cards from all graveyards to the battlefield under your control.
